messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["tortoise", "sheep"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large heavy-bodied tortoise shown in right-facing side profile standing on a small patch of sandy ground with sparse grass. It has a high domed shell with flared marginal scutes in brown and tan, and the entire top of the carapace is covered by a dense mass of thick curly shaggy brown wool-like fur that hangs down over the sides. The reptilian head is extended forward on a thick scaly neck, and the animal stands on four thick columnar scaly legs ending in short blunt claws, with a short tapered scaly tail protruding at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "reptilian with blunt beak, pebbly polygonal scales in gray-brown, dark eye and small nostril", "part": "head", "where": "at front right, extended forward from the shell"}, {"looks_like": "thick and wrinkled with small round pebbly scales", "part": "neck", "where": "between the head and the front opening of the shell"}, {"looks_like": "thick columnar with small pebbly scales below and large overlapping pointed conical scales on the upper front", "part": "front legs", "where": "under the front of the shell, two legs supporting the front body"}, {"looks_like": "thick columnar covered in small pebbly scales", "part": "hind legs", "where": "under the rear of the shell, two legs supporting the rear body"}, {"looks_like": "broad rounded with short blunt conical claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of each leg on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short tapered and pointed, covered in large rounded overlapping scales", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear left, protruding from under the back edge of the shell"}, {"looks_like": "domed with large polygonal scutes in striped dark brown and tan, flared serrated rim, yellow-brown on the sides and underside", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the middle of the body from behind the neck to above the tail"}, {"looks_like": "dense thick curly shaggy brown fleece like sheep's wool in clumps hanging over the edge", "part": "fur covering", "where": "covering the entire top of the shell and draping over the upper sides"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
